meta.title: Uzbekistan Business House | Kabul — one-stop service centre
meta.description: An official centre in Kabul for Uzbek and Afghan entrepreneurs: legal, accounting, marketing, logistics and B2B services in one place.
meta.ogDescription: A business bridge between Tashkent and Kabul. One window: law, finance, export-import and partnership.

img.heroAlt: Evening view of the Uzbekistan Business House building in Kabul

hero.title: Uzbekistan Business House
hero.subhead: A one-stop centre in Kabul providing legal, financial, marketing and logistics services for entrepreneurs from Uzbekistan and Afghanistan.

about.title: About the project
about.intro: The aim is to support business in Kabul on a one-stop-shop principle. The centre simplifies export-import, partner search and investment processes. It creates a secure, clear and official environment for companies from Uzbekistan and Afghanistan.

goals.title: Export expansion
goals.text: Bring Uzbek products to the Afghan market and find new buyers.

goals.title: Secure partnership
goals.text: Legal protection, contracts and guarantee mechanisms that build trust.

goals.title: Investment flow
goals.text: A practical platform for bilateral trade and investment projects.

services.title: Services
services.intro: The Kabul centre brings 12 service lines together — so an entrepreneur does not need a separate office for every issue.

items.title: Legal services
items.text: Contracts, registration and advice on local legislation.

items.title: Accounting and tax
items.text: Bookkeeping, reporting and tax compliance support.

items.title: Market research
items.text: Afghan market, pricing and competitor analysis, target segments.

items.title: Office in Kabul
items.text: Workspace, meeting rooms and a registered address.

items.title: Interpretation
items.text: Spoken and written translation in Uzbek, Dari, Pashto, Russian and English.

items.title: Visa and migration
items.text: Documents, invitation letters and process support.

items.title: B2B meetings
items.text: Partner matching, meeting plans and office rental.

items.title: Exhibitions and events
items.text: Stands, forums and tailored event production.

items.title: Export-import and guarantees
items.text: Contracts, certificates, customs and guarantee mechanisms.

items.title: Office in Tashkent
items.text: Workspace and address in Tashkent for Afghan entrepreneurs.

items.title: Warehouse and logistics
items.text: Storage, cargo tracking and supply-chain support.

pricing.title: Service packages
pricing.intro: Choose a monthly package or a project-based service. Final terms are confirmed after an enquiry.

extras.name: Interpretation
extras.note: Spoken interpretation for meetings and negotiations.

extras.name: Meeting room
extras.note: Equipped room, tea and technical support.

extras.name: Legal translation
extras.note: Translation of contracts and official documents.

stages.title: Implementation stages
stages.intro: The centre reaches full operations within 12 months. Each stage is tied to a clear result and accountability.

audience.title: Sectors of cooperation
audience.intro: The centre is open to businesses from both countries, with particular readiness in the following sectors.

items.title: Agriculture
items.text: Food, fruit and vegetables, and processing.

items.title: Textiles
items.text: Fabrics, ready-made garments and home textiles.

items.title: Education and IT
items.text: Talent, digital solutions and services export.
